## Overview

The following types provide methods to make RPCs. They are a good starting point
to learn about this library.

- `VideoStitcherServiceClient`: Video-On-Demand content stitching API allows you to insert ads into (VoD) video on demand files.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `VideoStitcherServiceClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudVideoStitcherV1
import GoogleLongRunning
import GoogleWKT

func sample(projectId: String, locationId: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudVideoStitcherV1.VideoStitcherServiceClient()
  let items = client.listCdnKeysByItems(
    request: ListCdnKeysRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "projects/\(projectId)/locations/\(locationId)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Requirements

For the minimum supported Swift version and platform requirements, see the

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-video-stitcher-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-video-stitcher-v1.git --from 0.5.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudVideoStitcherV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudVideoStitcherV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-video-stitcher-v1
```
